items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Yes and that band - with Rapola on the clarinet ---

ctx.x: It was a matter of weeks though - correct?

Yeah - it was a matter of weeks but I -- there used to be a place called "The Friers Inn" -- and that was near my hotel and I remember going down there one night just to see what was down there -- and, believe what was down there -- the New Orleans Rhythm -- Kings - with George Brunis and oh, man, I heard that band -- I couldn't believe it - you know ---
That was the first time you encountered Brunus---
